subject: general
question: Baking soda is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sodium hydrogen carbonate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Chemically known as sodium **hydrogencarbonate**, the formula of baking soda is NaHCO3.
 
• Baking soda is a white and crystalline salt that is made up of bicarbonate anion and sodium cation.​
